experiment: 5-fold person-grouped CV, transformer with a read-out per slice, 5 s slices (the 5 s Mamba run with a transformer)

input.normalisation: per slice and signal (slice average - video average) / video spread (ridge_5s_model.slice_levels), then z-scored with the fold's training videos and cut at +-4

epochs_rule: lowest inner-CV held-out loss (inner person-grouped 5-fold CV over the fold's training people, seeds averaged)

model.name: Transformer, read-out per slice
model.readout: linear on all 47 slice outputs (one weight vector per slice position)
model.norm: layer norm after attention and after feed-forward (nn.TransformerEncoderLayer defaults)
model.attention: over all 47 slices in both directions (no mask)

training.final: every seed trained on all of the fold's training videos for the chosen epochs; test logits averaged

references.ridge: ridge_5s_model.fit on the same folds (trained here)
references.mamba: saved test scores of D:\RidgeLIEdETECTOINvs3\results_mamba_5s_cv5\predictions_cv5.csv (forward Mamba, read-out per slice, same folds)
